purpose: development evaluation; independent acceptance remains pending

primary.aggregation: correct accepted windows / all accepted windows

candidate_rule: Report every seed. Compare fixed equal-probability three-seed ensembles on matched outer-fold endpoints. Prefer GRU unless the paired driver-bootstrap 95% CI for DANN minus GRU accuracy is strictly positive.

cross_validation.population: original train and validation subjects only
cross_validation.epoch_selection_scope: one fixed inner subject holdout in each outer fold

adaptation: none; normalization and domain head use inner train subjects only

test_policy.reason: Full UTA overlaps historical pilot subjects; a new independent cohort and locked candidate are required for final acceptance.
